# Independent alpha fixtures

These are the exact latest A03 manifest and five PNG inputs used by the Rust
decoder and compositing tests. They were copied from the local alpha-fixture-a01
diagnostic directory so a clean checkout can run those tests without production
scratch files. The manifest hash remains
`afdfb1848940b9063640871bf834c90c29ba2a2d4049811843514621dccb9ddc`.

Absolute paths inside the immutable manifest document the historical observer's
input locations. The Rust tests resolve the fixtures from this directory and do
not open those paths. Prior observer scripts, reports and A01/A02 manifests are
historical evidence retained on the Mac. This copy does not claim fresh observer
execution, playback or creative acceptance.
